description: Detects conflicting Tailwind utility classes in a className string — e.g. applying both 'flex' and 'grid', or multiple position utilities. Use to prevent silent CSS bugs before generating or reviewing component code.

class_string.description: Space-separated Tailwind class string to check for conflicts

config_path.description: Absolute path to tailwind.config.js or tailwind.config.ts

name: detect_css_conflicts
